The hours-long battle resulted in killing 59 people and wounding 71 others, while also displacing over 36029 residents. Witnesses reported that fighters beheaded elderly residents to spread terror. Ugandan military arrived later but found setting ablaze storage facilities. The attack near the area at coordinates 12.4N, 8.5E marks part of daily raids in the area. International Rescue Committee has condemned the ethnic violence.

Event_Description: In a devastating mass killing, RSF militia armed with automatic weapons attacked mosques in Nyala, Kutum locality, West Darfur on Sunday during the mid-morning, killing 43 people, wounding 76 others, and displacing over 46628 residents. The bandit attack lasted for daylong clashes as fighters besieged 58 miners, in revenge for killings last week. SAF troops confirmed the incident near the Nile River, Sudan, at coordinates 8.9N, 38.7E. Save the Children staff at a nearby NGO office reported destroying the local school. This is part of weekly incursions since provocations by rival groups.
MOTIVE: in revenge for killings last week

Event_Description: After disputed election results, JNIM fighters launched an attack on markets and a church in Mopti, Menaka cercle of Mopti Region, Mali, on Thursday afternoon in the early morning. Armed with grenades, militants shelled 26 displaced persons for control of territory, killing 40 people and wounding 83 others. The brief but deadly skirmish near the Sahel region at GPS location 6.5N, 3.4E led to displacing over 45137 residents. Malian Armed Forces reported burning down the village market from the revenge attack. World Food Programme confirmed this as part of intensified operations in the area.

Following the collapse of peace talks, Amhara militia launched an attack on farming communities and a NGO office in Bahir Dar, Adwa District of Oromia Region, Ethiopia, on last week in the afternoon. Armed using suicide vests, militants ransacked 62 market vendors to punish alleged collaborators, killing 39 people and wounding 35 others. The several hours of fighting near the Tekeze River at position 9.1N, 7.5E led to displacing over 1355 residents. Ethiopian National Defense Force reported demolishing public buildings from the retaliatory violence. Islamic Relief confirmed this as part of continuous assaults in the area.

Event_Description: Following a military offensive, ADF militants launched a bombing on highways and a church in Bukavu, Rutshuru territory of South Kivu, DRC, on January 15 in the at dawn. Armed with small arms, militants bombed 74 fishermen in retaliation for previous attacks, killing 153 people and wounding 130 others. The three-hour assault near Lake Kivu shores at coordinates 12.4N, 8.5E led to displacing over 5852 residents. Congolese army reported destroying over 50 homes from the bandit attack. World Food Programme confirmed this as part of ongoing violence in the area.

In a devastating shelling, armed groups armed with knives and clubs attacked checkpoints in Diffa, Banibangou Department, Tillaberi Region on Wednesday during the night, killing 40 people, wounding 135 others, and displacing over 21556 residents. The revenge attack lasted for daylong clashes as fighters besieged 88 villagers, over cattle theft. Nigerien forces confirmed the incident near the desert zone, Niger, at coordinates 12.4N, 8.5E. Save the Children staff at a nearby hospital reported setting ablaze storage facilities. This is part of sporadic clashes since the breakdown of a ceasefire.

Event_Description: Survivors described an attack by Cabo Delgado insurgents in Palma District, Mocimboa da Praia, Nampula Province, Mozambique on May 25 night, where armed fighters using improvised explosive devices set fire to UN compounds near a mosque, killing 51 people including villagers, and wounding 74 others. The daylong clashes of bandit attack to destabilize the region led to displacing over 41175 residents from villages near the Rovuma River at position 9.1N, 7.5E. Mozambican armed forces found destroying over 50 homes. CARE International says this continues ongoing violence after a land boundary dispute.
